description: Installs, upgrades and removes the StormForge agent on CloudBolt-built EKS, AKS and GKE clusters through the StormForge API and an in-cluster Helm job, applies StormForge recommendations to workloads in the namespaces on those clusters, and sets StormForge optimization settings on the clusters, namespaces and workloads.
label: StormForge
name: stormforge
